# PDFium public headers

These are the three public headers used by `samosa-extract`, from the
`chromium/7961` (`152.0.7961.0`) release of
[bblanchon/pdfium-binaries](https://github.com/bblanchon/pdfium-binaries/releases/tag/chromium%2F7961).
They match the reviewed `dist/libpdfium.dylib` byte-for-byte library artifact.

Source archive: `pdfium-mac-arm64.tgz`
SHA-256: `1193a771e0bd934530afa3df73a0d44551d8f4078442e290054e6dd38ded960f`
Library SHA-256: `c2f68f87106da4f0cb6d6a90a7aad9644b3c1cb92a3463dbdc8f39449aec3869`

The headers retain their upstream BSD-style notices. The binary distribution
project is MIT-licensed; PDFium itself is BSD-3-Clause.
